newsitem.title: USA: Businessman rapes woman he met on the Internet.
newsitem.headline: Businessman rapes woman he met on the Internet.

text.p: A New York businessman was arrested on Sunday and charged with beating, raping and sodomizing a woman he met on the Internet, police said.
A police spokeswoman said Paul Krath, 46, met the victim, a 41-year-old woman from Syracuse, N.Y., through an Internet chat room six weeks ago.

After weeks of electronic chatter, the woman travelled to New York on Friday to meet Krath. "They had dinner and conversation at his Greenwich Village apartment and during the evening he allegedly raped, beat and sodomized her," the spokeswoman said.
The woman was "in severe pain" when she approached police for help and was treated at a New York hospital. Krath is to be arraigned in Manhattan Criminal Court on Monday.
